name: simoptix_vr_mirror
description: Stabilized VR footage of Le Mans Ultimate, from a Pimax headset or through OpenXR, and race auto-record.
long_description: SimOptix: VR Mirror adds two OBS sources with the stabilized headset view. SimOptix: Pimax Mirror takes the copy of the left eye that Pimax Play makes. SimOptix: OpenXR Mirror takes the game's own left eye through SimOptix's OpenXR API layer. Race auto-record makes OBS record each LMU race by itself.
